name: hls-player
description: A small browser extension that plays HLS (.m3u8) streams directly in a clean video player.

scripts.lint: npm run vendor && web-ext lint --warnings-as-errors --source-dir extension
scripts.build: npm run vendor && web-ext build --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:unlisted: npm run vendor && web-ext sign --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist --channel unlisted
scripts.sign:listed: npm run source && npm run vendor && web-ext sign --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --upload-source-code dist/source.zip
